description: This file defines a custom hook or utility function in TypeScript for diagnostics-related API calls within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to notify about the start of installer and upgrader processes by sending POST requests via an injected API service.

methods.name: export default function useDiagnostics(http: APIService) { useDiagnostics
methods.description: Main function exporting diagnostic notification methods; takes an APIService instance and returns functions to notify about installer and upgrader start events.

methods.name: notifyInstallerStart
methods.description: Sends a POST request to '/installer/api/send-data/installer-start' to notify the start of an installer process.

methods.name: notifyUpgraderStart
methods.description: Sends a POST request to '/installer/api/send-data/upgrader-start' to notify the start of an upgrader process.
